product_overview: DeepVizify is a data analytics SaaS that lets non-technical users upload, clean, visualize datasets and get AI-generated insights and reports. The current codebase provides a React frontend with demo visualizations and needs backend, parsing, persistence and real analytics integration.
core_goals: Enable reliable file import (CSV/Excel/JSON), parse and preview uploaded datasets.
Provide a global dataset store so EDA, cleaning, visualization and AI features share the same data.
Deliver real EDA and data cleaning operations (missing values, duplicates, type casting, outlier detection).
Render visualizations from user data with selectable X/Y columns and chart-type switching.
Integrate AI (OpenAI/Claude) to generate real insights from the uploaded dataset.
Support PDF/HTML report generation containing charts, stats and AI insights.
Add user authentication and data persistence (Supabase or equivalent) for multi-user SaaS usage.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allow users to sign up and sign in so projects, datasets, and analysis can be persisted per user.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign Up button -> See success confirmation -> Redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button -> See authentication error message

features.name: Global Data Store
features.description: A central client-side store (React Context/Zustand) that holds uploaded datasets, cleaned versions, EDA results and AI insights so all tabs share state.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Data Import sidebar button -> Upload file -> System stores dataset in global store -> See dataset listed in Datasets panel
Navigate to /dashboard -> Upload file -> System fails to persist dataset due to storage error -> See global store error notification

features.name: File Upload & Parse
features.description: Upload CSV, Excel, or JSON files; parse them client-side (PapaParse/SheetJS), detect sheets/rows and show a first-rows preview.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Click Upload or Browse Files button -> Select CSV file -> Browser reads file -> Parser parses file -> See file preview with first 10 rows
Navigate to /projects -> Click Upload or Browse Files button -> Select .xlsx file -> Browser reads file -> Parser enumerates sheets -> See sheet selector in UI
Navigate to /projects -> Click Upload or Browse Files button -> Select corrupted CSV file -> Parser fails to parse -> See file parse error message

features.name: Parse & Validate (Schema Inference)
features.description: Automatically infer column names and types, compute null counts and basic metadata, and validate file format and headers.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Upload file -> System auto-detects column names -> System auto-detects column types -> See dataset metadata panel with column counts and null%
Navigate to /projects -> Upload file with nested JSON -> System flattens JSON arrays -> See flattened preview table
Navigate to /projects -> Upload file with missing headers -> System detects missing headers -> See validation error prompting user to provide headers

features.name: Data Cleaning
features.description: Run data quality scans on the uploaded dataset to detect missing values, duplicates, outliers and offer fix actions (fill, drop, cast).
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Cleaning tab -> Click Start Analysis -> System calculates missing values per column -> User selects Mean fill option for numeric column -> Click Apply -> See updated completeness metric
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Cleaning tab -> Click Start Analysis -> System finds duplicate rows -> User clicks Remove Duplicates -> See duplicate count decrease
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Cleaning tab -> Click Start Analysis -> User tries to apply Mean fill on non-numeric column -> See action disabled message

features.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
features.description: Automatically generate summary statistics, distributions, correlation matrix and category counts for the uploaded dataset.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click EDA or Visualization tab -> System displays auto summary table for all columns -> User views distribution histogram for numeric column -> See histogram rendered
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click EDA tab -> System computes correlation matrix -> User opens heatmap view -> See correlation heatmap
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click EDA tab -> Dataset not loaded -> See 'No data' message

features.name: Visualization (Chart Builder)
features.description: Allow users to select columns for X and Y axes, switch chart types (area/bar/pie), aggregate and export charts generated from real dataset values.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Visualization tab -> Click Column selector -> Select X column -> Select Y column -> Click Chart Type Bar -> See chart rendered with selected columns
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Visualization tab -> Select X column -> Select Y column -> Click Export Chart button -> Download PNG starts
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Visualization tab -> Select non-numeric column for Y -> Click Chart Type Bar -> See validation error 'Y must be numeric'

features.name: AI Analytics (Insights Generation)
features.description: Send dataset summaries or user questions to an AI API (OpenAI/Claude) and surface actionable insights, anomaly detection and natural language explanations.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Analytics tab -> Click Generate Insights -> System sends dataset sample to AI API -> Receive insights text -> See AI insights panel populated
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Analytics tab -> Ask AI question via Chart Bot -> System sends question and sample to AI API -> Receive answer with suggested charts -> See suggestion in Chart Bot
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Analytics tab -> Click Generate Insights -> AI API call fails or times out -> See 'AI integration error' message

features.name: Reports (Export)
features.description: Compile EDA, cleaned data summary, charts and AI insights into PDF or HTML reports that can be downloaded or shared.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Reports tab -> Click Create First Report -> Select datasets and charts -> Click Generate PDF -> See download start and report file saved
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Reports tab -> Click Create First Report -> Leave dataset selection empty -> Click Generate PDF -> See validation error 'Select at least one dataset'

features.name: Projects & Dataset Management
features.description: Create and manage projects that group datasets, charts and reports; list datasets with metadata and allow preview, delete, and open actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> Click Create New Project -> Enter project name -> Click Create -> See project added to list
Navigate to /projects -> Click project entry -> Click Upload dataset -> Select file -> See dataset added under project
Navigate to /projects -> Click Create New Project -> Leave project name empty -> Click Create -> See validation error 'Name required'

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: Allow authenticated users to view and update their account details and preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View current account details -> Click Edit -> Update profile fields -> Click Save -> See success confirmation
Navigate to /profile -> Click Edit -> Enter invalid email -> Click Save -> See validation error on email field

features.name: Dashboard Visualization
features.description: View data visualizations on the dashboard
